title: Agroforestry Tree Species Identification (India, Multimodal)
description: This open dataset supports individual tree species identification in agroforestry settings using multimodal remote-sensing and tree-level metadata. Each example corresponds to a single tree and links across SkySat RGB crops, Sentinel-1 time series, Sentinel-2 time series, PlanetScope time series, species labels, and derived species-classification vectors. The release contains 23,156 tree examples. Raw Google Street View imagery is not redistributed; panorama IDs and related metadata are retained to support reproducible workflows where users have appropriate API access and rights. Manifests and metadata files are included to support reliable joins across modalities and data splits.
